title: Stat Row
description: A row of KPI stats with deltas, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: each stat is a card with its label, its value in the display face and its change tinted by whether that change is good news, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — two stats a row and the header lined up at @sm, larger values at @md, four stats a row at @lg.
